tool_args.rationale: The fitted siphon law reproduces every paid observation to within 5e-8, including both wide-gradient probe rows. Its fitted rho is approximately 0.912, rather than assuming the archived cross-source range.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The simpler archived siphon with a positive square-root branch fits all seven observations to approximately their rounding precision.
The stationary siphon already explains the observed input and sink-gradient variation; an ODE-specific probe is not needed before confirmation.
